prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable transparent devotional celestial-chakra illustration for a native mobile app.
Primary request: Create ONE full uncropped isolated celestial wheel drawn in delicate warm ochre ink, faithful to the chakra motif from the supplied devotional image and the two approved mobile placements.
Input images: Image 1 is the ornamental subject/style reference; ignore its room, lamps, flowers and fabric. Image 2 is the approved faint large Panchang backdrop and Image 3 is the approved right-side Home Today card ornament; these define the exact fine-line ornament style, not a request for a UI screenshot.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent RGBA background, no white, parchment or checkerboard pixels.
Subject: one circular wheel with a central softly textured sun disc and long flowing wavy rays; a ring of tiny dots; several fine concentric orbital circles divided by slender radial spokes; a restrained alternating rhythm of crescent moons, eight-point stars and simple planet discs in the outer ring; small leaf-shaped points facing outward on the perimeter.
Style/medium: refined hand-illustrated devotional almanac engraving, exceptionally crisp delicate linework, lightly irregular painterly ink, matching the gentle golden ochre ornament of approved screenshots. No heavy raised metallic effect.
Composition/framing: front-facing circular wheel centered exactly in a square 1024 by 1024 image, full wheel visible with uniform small margins of about 4 percent on all four sides. Radial circular structure mathematically balanced, no tilt or perspective. All leaf tips remain inside the canvas.
Color palette: predominantly muted golden ochre and amber near #B8833B; subtle lighter warm gold inside sun and discs, no purple, blue, black or bright yellow. The app will apply opacity, so illustration ink should be fully visible at source.
Constraints: one illustration only, no caption, no text, no Sanskrit, no zodiac glyphs, no numbers, no logo, no watermark; no frame or external square border; no photo backdrop, no objects other than the wheel. Preserve true transparency even inside gaps between rings and spokes. Avoid opacity haze or any solid background.

packaging.description: Uniform Lanczos downscale and centering on transparent 1024px canvas using alpha >= 16 visible artwork bounds; lossless PNG compression; no pixels painted or recolored.

output.role: unquantized packaged intermediate before final indexed-alpha compression

finalShippedAsset.packaging: Generated RGBA downsampled/centered as recorded in provenance; indexed 256-color alpha PNG packaging with Pillow FASTOCTREE, no dithering. Original unquantized master retained.
